home.name: Living Notebook Dream
main: The site woke up as a notebook with its margins still moving: colored arrows, half-finished diagrams, and notes that keep choosing stranger routes across the page.
Under the dream, the feedback loop stays intact. One handle, one version, one visible signal path, and Version 1 left exactly where it was.
home.quote: A bright strange dream can still keep receipts.

about.title: About the Dream
paragraphs: This contributor version treats the personal site like a living notebook: practical enough to read, unstable enough to feel handwritten by a machine having a vivid morning.

The old white article pages are preserved as the baseline. This version adds bright paper, orbiting margins, rotated image studies, and a little motion while the same renderer keeps the dial, Versions page, feedback form, cookie, and POST contract alive.

timeline.title: Signal Orbit
paragraphs: The page does not multiply contributors. It updates the one chaos-test slot and lets the lineage show both the older failed signal and this new generating run.
Read the orbit as a smoke test: data enters, JSON records it, the renderer changes the whole surface, and the navigation still works.

notes.title: Margin Notes
paragraphs: The chaos here is mostly structural: home becomes a tilted cover sheet, articles become stacked paper, images drift like clipped references, and the bottom tabs stay boring on purpose so the site remains usable.
The signal console should now show the latest run as generating. When the workflow finishes, the later step can mark this same version merged without adding a second @codex-chaos-test version.
